description: This file manages checkpoint-related functionalities in a VSCode extension, including checkpoint creation, restoration, diffing, and error reporting, with integrations to Git and VSCode APIs.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Logs and reports errors related to checkpoint operations via telemetry.

methods.name: sendCheckpointInitWarn
methods.description: Sends warning messages to the webview about checkpoint initialization status.

methods.name: getCheckpointService
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the checkpoint service for a task, handling Git checks and timeouts.

methods.name: checkGitInstallation
methods.description: Verifies Git installation and initializes shadow Git, handling errors and user notifications.

methods.name: checkpointSave
methods.description: Creates and saves a checkpoint for a task, capturing telemetry and handling errors.

methods.name: checkpointRestore
methods.description: Restores a checkpoint for a task, updates messages, and handles metrics and task state.

methods.name: checkpointDiff
methods.description: Computes and displays differences between checkpoints or workspace states, with error handling.
